tasks.description: Update the Manifests section of format/spec.md: the current text states 'A manifest is an immutable Avro file' and describes metadata stored 'as properties in the Avro file's key-value metadata'. Revise to state that v1-v3 manifests are Avro, while v4 manifests may be Avro or Parquet (data and delete manifests), and describe how metadata is stored for Parquet manifests. Also note that unpartitioned manifests omit the partition field in Parquet since Parquet cannot store empty structs.

Add a 'Version 4' subsection to Appendix E: Format version changes in format/spec.md documenting that v4 tables write data and delete manifests as Parquet by default, that v4 readers/writers support both Avro and Parquet when explicitly selected, and the unpartitioned-manifest partition-field handling.
